summary: Tested patient safety APIs and end-to-end Consult Timeline, allergy alert, and voice-to-vitals flows against the public URL. Backend passed 9/9 tests, including literal '+' phone timeline regression, four-source event aggregation, allergy persistence, Penicillin conflict behavior, and requested regressions. Frontend core flows passed; one route mismatch remains: the requested /appointments/{id}/vitals URL redirects to the landing page, although the Appointment Details 'Take Vitals' flow correctly opens /vitals/{id} and dictation does not crash.

integration_issues.issue: The requested /appointments/{id}/vitals route is not registered and falls through to the wildcard redirect at '/'. VitalsEntry is available only at /vitals/{id}; the in-app Take Vitals button works via that route.

action_items: Register /appointments/:appointmentId/vitals as a protected alias for VitalsEntry or standardize all documentation and links on /vitals/:appointmentId.
Do not silently swallow /safety/drug-check failures in PrescriptionWriter; show a safety-check unavailable/error state so an API failure cannot be mistaken for a safe prescription.
critical_code_review_comments: PrescriptionWriter's debounced clinical safety request catches every error silently and clears/retains no explicit failure state. In a clinical workflow this fail-open behavior can hide unavailable allergy checks.
App.js registers only /vitals/:appointmentId; the wildcard route redirects the requested nested vitals URL to the public landing page.

PrescriptionWriter.js currently has four ESLint errors, including react/no-unstable-nested-components for MicButton defined inside PrescriptionWriter; this recreates the component type on each parent render.

success_rate.frontend: 88.9% (8/9 checked flows passed; all in-app feature flows passed, direct requested nested vitals route failed)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests inserted one isolated TEST appointment, prescription, invoice, ambient session, and patient_safety allergy record under the supplied doctor, then removed all of them. UI testing temporarily replaced one existing patient's allergy list with Penicillin and restored the original list in cleanup.
test_credentials: Used Doctor / Test Professional credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_safety_timeline.py. For UI, login as the supplied doctor, verify /appointments/{id}/vitals directly after route alignment, then click vitals-dictate-btn. Existing in-app route /vitals/{id} passed. Clients showed 17 cards and both history buttons; both timeline dialogs loaded events; safety banner appeared for Penicillin V and cleared for Amoxicillin.
rca_of_the_issue: Timeline crash regression is resolved: safety.py now applies re.escape(client_phone) before the ambient_sessions Mongo regex, and literal '+' phones return 200. Remaining route defect RCA: App.js defines /vitals/:appointmentId but no /appointments/:appointmentId/vitals alias; the catch-all route therefore redirects the requested URL to '/'.
